Innkeepers Act 1921

REPEALED

Repealed by Act 2 of 2021 with effect from 01 Mar 2021

Current version as at 28 Feb 2021

An Act relating to the liability of innkeepers.

Short title

1. This Act is the Innkeepers Act 1921.

Liability of innkeeper limited

2. An innkeeper is not liable to make good to any guest any loss of or injury to goods brought to the inn beyond the sum of $500.
